title: Pure Magnet Warrior
summary: The pure Magnet Warrior build featuring the 2026 Burst Protocol support (Sigma Minus, Sigma Plus, Omega Plus, Tellusion, Conduction Warrior, and Flux Ochsenfeld) alongside the classic Electromagnet and Magnet Warriors.

summary.title: Starters
points: Beta The Electromagnet Warrior searches a Level 4 or lower Magnet Warrior on summon, while Alpha The Electromagnet Warrior searches a Level 8 Magna Warrior.
Magnet Warrior Sigma Minus reveals itself in the hand to Fusion Summon a Rock Fusion Monster, and mills a Level 8 Magna Warrior when summoned.
Magnet Bonding searches a Magnet Warrior, Magna Warrior, or Conduction Warrior Linear Magnum Plus Minus, or Fusion Summons a Rock Fusion by shuffling Rocks back.

summary.title: Opening: Beta + Sigma Minus
steps: Normal Summon Beta The Electromagnet Warrior to search Magnet Warrior Sigma Plus.
Reveal Magnet Warrior Sigma Minus in the hand to Fusion Summon Conduction Warrior Plasma Magnum using Beta and Sigma Plus.
Plasma Magnum searches Magnet Bonding and grants an extra Magnet Warrior Normal Summon, while Sigma Plus revives or recovers a Magnet Warrior.
Normal Summon Sigma Minus to mill Tellusion the Magna Warrior, then banish Sigma Minus and Sigma Plus from the GY to Special Summon Tellusion.

summary.title: Electromagnet Tagging & Normal Targets
summary.text: Alpha, Beta, and Gamma The Electromagnet Warrior each Tribute themselves as a Quick Effect on the opponent's turn to Special Summon a Level 4 Magnet Warrior from the Deck. Single copies of the classic Normal Monsters Alpha, Beta, and Gamma The Magnet Warrior serve as their tag-in targets and fuel Delta The Magnet Warrior to summon Valkyrion the Magna Warrior.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Tellusion the Magna Warrior rises from the GY by banishing both Sigmas and destroys or steals an opponent's monster during their turn.
Berserkion the Electromagna Warrior banishes Alpha, Beta, and Gamma from the hand, field, or GY to summon itself and banishes Rocks from the GY to destroy cards.
Imperion Magnum the Superconductive Battlebot fuses Valkyrion and Berserkion for a 4000 ATK boss that negates monster effects, Spells, and Traps.
Flux Ochsenfeld revives a Rock and bounces a card, while Magnet Warrior Omega Plus Tributes itself to flip an opposing monster face-down.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Magnet Bonding acts as both a starter and a Rock Fusion Spell that recycles banished or GY Rocks, searchable by Conduction Warrior Plasma Magnum.
Magnet Induction summons a Magnet Warrior from the Deck and protects your Magnet Warriors from destruction for the turn.
Magnetic Field revives a Level 4 or lower EARTH Rock each turn and bounces monsters that battle your Rocks, while Magnet Conversion recycles three Magnet Warriors from the GY.
